question: What does the Fireworks CS6 splash screen look like? The user wants a transparent splash page/graphic similar to the original.
probes: Extract splash resources from the Fireworks.exe binary (icons, bitmaps, dialogs)
Check PE resources for splash-related entries
resolution: Splash screen: Adobe Fireworks CS6 uses ABPG (Adobe Binary PNG) resources (resource IDs 29998, 29999, 30000 at 0x189dfac, 0x18a5524, 0x18afca0) as splash/art assets. The splash is an Adobe Binary PNG, not a standard PNG. Implementation: dark themed splash screen with FireCraft branding was created using egui window.
